promotionDecision.rationale: The implementation promoted only rows with an explicit content/prefab AchievementSubTaskData.TaskTitle ownership chain. Actual quest title/flavor localization nodes remain source-adjacent until ManagedAchievementData rows are dumped or otherwise recovered.

nextBestJoinPrompt: Export or locate managed quest rows keyed by prefab GUID/entity id with ManagedAchievementData.Quest.Key/Text, ManagedAchievementData.Flavor.Key/Text, AchievementData.Reward, and AchievementSubTaskEntry prefab IDs. Join those keys to Bloodcraft Resources/Localization/English.json and accept promotion only when the prefab id and localization GUID are present in the same managed row.

actionableNow: AchievementsSystem._State.TrackVBloodSource carries tracked VBlood PrefabGUID and can anchor visible tracker state to prefab/entity IDs.
VBloodTrackingUnitEntry.UnitPrefabGuid exposes menu-side prefab GUIDs for visible VBlood tracker entries.
notLocalizationAuthority: LocalizedText.ForceSet and TextMeshProUGUI.SetText overwrite UI text directly; no localization GUID/key lookup path is exposed.
Hardcoded _vBloodNamesPrefabGuid dictionary is useful as a sanity checklist, not canonical enrichment authority.
followUpLeads.suggestedUse: Use as a future runtime/client UI join pattern for VBlood tracker rows, not as a journal quest title/flavor localization source.
